# The `my.*` options

<!-- Generated by `nix run .#write-docs` from the option declarations; do not edit. -->

Per-machine settings. Shared modules read `config.my.*` instead of
hard-coding the user, domain, addresses or devices; a host sets them in
`modules/hosts/<name>/default.nix`. Defaults are the declared ones, as
the template host sees them.

## my\.ambilight\.enable

Whether to enable HyperHDR ambient lighting from screen capture\.



*Type:*
boolean



*Default:*

```nix
false
```



*Example:*

```nix
true
```

*Declared by:*
 - [modules/my\.nix](../modules/my.nix)



## my\.ambilight\.musicSink



PipeWire sink whose output HyperHDR captures for music effects (` pw-cli ls Node `)\.



*Type:*
null or string



*Default:*

```nix
null
```



*Example:*

```nix
"alsa_output.usb-iFi__by_AMR__iFi__by_AMR__HD_USB_Audio_0003-00.analog-stereo"
```

*Declared by:*
 - [modules/my\.nix](../modules/my.nix)



## my\.ambilight\.wledUrl



WLED controller the dashboard’s ambilight buttons switch\.



*Type:*
null or string matching the pattern https?://\[^ ]+



*Default:*

```nix
null
```



*Example:*

```nix
"http://192.168.1.118"
```

*Declared by:*
 - [modules/my\.nix](../modules/my.nix)



## my\.flakePath



Checkout of this repository that live desktop configs link to
(Umbriel, Noctalia)\. Home Manager points those files at it with
out-of-store symlinks, so saving the file there applies the change
without a rebuild\.



*Type:*
string matching the pattern /\.\*



*Default:*

```nix
"/etc/nixos"
```

*Declared by:*
 - [modules/my\.nix](../modules/my.nix)



## my\.headphoneEq\.enable



Whether to enable a parametric headphone EQ sink (PipeWire filter-chain), switched on with ` headphone-eq on `\.



*Type:*
boolean



*Default:*

```nix
false
```



*Example:*

```nix
true
```

*Declared by:*
 - [modules/my\.nix](../modules/my.nix)



## my\.headphoneEq\.bands



Parametric EQ bands (frequency in Hz, gain in dB)\.



*Type:*

*Default:*

```nix

    gain = 1.4;
    q = 3.18;

    q = 1.66;

    type = "peak";
  }
  {
    freq = 3697;
    gain = 5.1;
    q = 3.64;
    type = "peak";
  }
  {
    freq = 5160;
    gain = -5.6;
    q = 5.03;
    type = "peak";
  }
  {
    freq = 6011;

    q = 3.01;
    type = "peak";
  }

  }
  {

    type = "highshelf";
  }
]
```

*Declared by:*
 - [modules/my\.nix](../modules/my.nix)



## my\.headphoneEq\.bands\.\*\.freq



Centre or corner frequency in Hz\.



*Type:*

 - [modules/my\.nix](../modules/my.nix)

Gain in dB\.



*Type:*

 - [modules/my\.nix](../modules/my.nix)



## my\.headphoneEq\.bands\.\*\.q



Quality factor (bandwidth)\.



*Type:*

## my\.headphoneEq\.bands\.\*\.type

## my\.liquidGlass\.enable



Whether to enable liquid glass: Umbriel’s glass under windows, Noctalia’s panels and the
terminals’ rim (home/umbriel/glass\.toml), and the glass under the lock
screen and greeter login boxes (Noctalia patches)\. Off, they keep plain blur\.



*Type:*
boolean



*Default:*

```nix
false
```



*Example:*

```nix
true
```

*Declared by:*
 - [modules/my\.nix](../modules/my.nix)



## my\.macApproval\.enable



Whether to enable sudo and polkit approval through a forwarded Mac SSH agent\.



*Type:*
boolean



*Default:*

```nix
false
```



*Example:*

```nix

```

*Declared by:*
 - [modules/my\.nix](../modules/my.nix)



## my\.macApproval\.addresses



The Mac’s Tailscale and LAN addresses; sshd drops its sessions when it sleeps\.



*Type:*
list of string



*Default:*

```nix
  "100.127.94.102"
  "192.168.1.97"
]
```

*Declared by:*
 - [modules/my\.nix](../modules/my.nix)

## my\.network\.domain



Public domain; services are served on its subdomains\.



*Type:*
string matching the pattern (\[a-z0-9-]+\\\.)+\[a-z]+



*Example:*

```nix
"erebor.jzon.pl"
```

*Declared by:*
 - [modules/my\.nix](../modules/my.nix)



## my\.network\.lanInterface



LAN interface whose firewall allows local services (SSH, media, sync)\.



*Type:*
string matching the pattern \[A-Za-z0-9\._-]{1,15}



*Example:*

```nix
"br0"
```

*Declared by:*
 - [modules/my\.nix](../modules/my.nix)



## my\.network\.ovhDns\.enable



Whether to enable certificates for my\.network\.domain and its subdomains through OVH’s DNS
API\. Needs the ovh_\* secrets in secrets/\<host>\.yaml; off, Caddy uses its
default ACME challenges, which cannot issue the wildcard certificate\.



*Type:*
boolean



*Default:*

```nix
false
```



*Example:*

```nix
true
```

*Declared by:*
 - [modules/my\.nix](../modules/my.nix)



## my\.sequoiaWallpaper\.enable



Whether to enable the live ` sequoia: ` wallpaper in Noctalia (the macOS Sequoia scene, animated on
the lock screen)\. Needs the scene file in ~/\.local/share/sequoia, which is not
in the repository\.



*Type:*
boolean



*Default:*

```nix
false
```



*Example:*

```nix
true
```

*Declared by:*
 - [modules/my\.nix](../modules/my.nix)



## my\.services



Web services behind Caddy\. Each modules/services file declares its
entry; hosts set ` my.services.<name>.enable `\. Routes, /etc/hosts names
and LAN firewall ports are generated from this registry\.



*Type:*
attribute set of (submodule)



*Default:*

```nix
{ }
```

*Declared by:*
 - [modules/my\.nix](../modules/my.nix)



## my\.services\.\<name>\.enable



Whether to enable the ‹name› service, with its web routes and LAN port\.



*Type:*
boolean



*Default:*

```nix
false
```



*Example:*

```nix
true
```

*Declared by:*
 - [modules/my\.nix](../modules/my.nix)



## my\.services\.\<name>\.extraConfig



Caddy directives placed before reverse_proxy in the public route\.



*Type:*
strings concatenated with “\\n”



*Default:*

```nix
""
```

*Declared by:*
 - [modules/my\.nix](../modules/my.nix)



## my\.services\.\<name>\.lanPort



Plain-HTTP port Caddy listens on, opened on the LAN interface\.



*Type:*
null or 16 bit unsigned integer; between 0 and 65535 (both inclusive)



*Default:*

```nix
null
```

*Declared by:*
 - [modules/my\.nix](../modules/my.nix)



## my\.services\.\<name>\.localName



Bare name served on :80 as ` <name> ` and ` <name>.localhost `, also added to /etc/hosts\.



*Type:*
null or string



*Default:*

```nix
null
```



*Example:*

```nix
"jellyfin"
```

*Declared by:*
 - [modules/my\.nix](../modules/my.nix)



## my\.services\.\<name>\.port



Loopback port Caddy proxies to\.



*Type:*
16 bit unsigned integer; between 0 and 65535 (both inclusive)

*Declared by:*
 - [modules/my\.nix](../modules/my.nix)



## my\.services\.\<name>\.proxy\.headers



` header_up ` arguments for the local and public routes\.



*Type:*
list of string



*Default:*

```nix
[ ]
```



*Example:*

```nix
[
  "Host localhost:18384"
  "-Authorization"
]
```

*Declared by:*
 - [modules/my\.nix](../modules/my.nix)



## my\.services\.\<name>\.proxy\.https



The upstream speaks HTTPS\.



*Type:*
boolean



*Default:*

```nix
false
```

*Declared by:*
 - [modules/my\.nix](../modules/my.nix)



## my\.services\.\<name>\.proxy\.lanHeaders



` header_up ` arguments for the LAN port block\.



*Type:*
list of string



*Default:*


*Declared by:*

## my\.services\.\<name>\.proxy\.tlsInsecure



Skip upstream certificate checks (self-signed loopback HTTPS)\.

boolean



*Default:*


## my\.services\.\<name>\.publicName



Subdomain of my\.network\.domain served over HTTPS\.

null or string



*Default:*




*Example:*


*Declared by:*
 - [modules/my\.nix](../modules/my.nix)

## my\.taskBoard\.enable



Whether to enable the read-only task card in the dashboard hub for administrators\. The
control API runs ` scripts/erebor-tasks list --json ` on ` flakePath `, so
the counts follow the checkout without a rebuild
\.



*Type:*
boolean



*Default:*

```nix
false
```



*Example:*

```nix
true
```

*Declared by:*
 - [modules/my\.nix](../modules/my.nix)



## my\.taskBoard\.linkBase



URL prefix that makes task file paths (tasks/SYS-NNN\.md) into links; null shows no links\.



*Type:*
null or string matching the pattern https?://\[^ ]+



*Default:*

```nix
null
```



*Example:*

```nix
"https://github.com/owner/nixos-config/blob/master/"
```

*Declared by:*
 - [modules/my\.nix](../modules/my.nix)


## my\.yubikey\.enable



Whether to enable YubiKey (pam_u2f) touch for sudo, with a touch notification\.



*Type:*
boolean



*Default:*

```nix

```



*Example:*

```nix

```

*Declared by:*
 - [modules/my\.nix](../modules/my.nix)



## my\.yubikey\.lockOnRemoval



Whether to enable locking every session (` loginctl lock-sessions `) when a YubiKey is unplugged and
none is back within two seconds\. Password and fingerprint still unlock\.



*Type:*
boolean



*Default:*

```nix
false
```



*Example:*

```nix
true
```

*Declared by:*
 - [modules/my\.nix](../modules/my.nix)
